text:
olivia_partnerships: Quick sync — Equinix Metal partner asked for a tiny reference-arch + Terraform module so customers can deploy Redwood Private on bare-metal with private network peering. Goal: publish a hands-on quickstart and a reusable module by EOW. Thoughts?

raj_eng_infra: Love it. Key ask from infra: automation for BGP/VLANs + a simple way to attach KMS/HSM and VPN. Also need clear sizing guidance (GPU counts, NICs).

mina_devex: We should make the quickstart a 15-20 min workshop. Include a checklist: prereqs (API key, project, VLAN), one `terraform apply`, then health checks.

alex_solutions: From solutions side, customers will want an option for either Equinix-provided colocated GPUs or bring-your-own GPU chassis. Module should accept a `node_type` var and a `provider_profile` map.

olivia_partnerships: @tanya_equnix — can you confirm which Equinix Metal APIs we should call for provisioning and if there's an official Terraform provider we can pin to?

tanya_equnix: hey! we recommend the `equinix-metal` provider (registry.terraform.io/equinix/equinix-metal). For GPUs, we'll advise their "baremetal-accelerator" SKUs. We can provide sample project IDs + test account. happy to pair for an initial run. :smile:

raj_eng_infra: Nice. For networking we'll include two modules: `equinix_network` (VLANs, BGP) and `redwood_onprem` (nodes, kube, secrets). Suggest we surface these vars: `vlan_id`, `bgp_asn`, `private_cidr`, `gpu_sku`, `ssh_key`.

mina_devex: Draft README should show this snippet for module consumption:

```
module "redwood_equx_quickstart" {
  source = "github.com/redwood-inference/partner-modules/equinix-metal//redwood-quickstart"
  project = var.equinix_project
  region = var.region
  node_type = var.node_type
  gpu_sku = var.gpu_sku
  vlan_id = var.vlan_id
  bgp_asn = var.bgp_asn
}
```

alex_solutions: Also include a `validate_inference.sh` script that runs a small gen request against a local containerized runtime so customers can smoke-test. Keep the script idempotent.

olivia_partnerships: Ops asks — licensing / marketplace listing? We don't plan a marketplace listing initially; just a partner repo + docs and a co-branded quickstart. If that works, we can expand to a marketplace offering.

tanya_equinix: Co-branded quickstart works. I'll provide a sample billing SKU list and a contact for account-level quotas.

raj_eng_infra: I'll start a repo under `redwood-infra/partner-modules/equinix-metal` and add the skeleton with `README.md`, `modules/network`, `modules/compute`, `examples/quickstart`.

mina_devex: I'll draft the workshop guide and a short Loom demo. We should aim to keep Terraform state examples minimal — use S3/GCS backend examples but call out on-prem alternatives.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline created: redwood-infra/partner-modules/equinix-metal -> tests/terraform-smoke (status: queued)

olivia_partnerships: Perfect. Action items: Raj init repo + skeleton (owner), Mina draft workshop & README (owner), Tanya supply SKUs + test accounts (owner). Target: initial PR by Thu. :thumbsup:

alex_solutions: I'll prepare the `validate_inference.sh` and a small container image spec.

tanya_equinix: I'll DM credentials and sample project IDs later today.

olivia_partnerships: Thanks everyone — will track in the partnerships board.
